reopen_history.reason: attempt_0003/concept.sql:35 maps Observation.effective_datetime through CAST(TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(...)), pinned-format) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The offset-aware parser re-renders the instant in spark.sql.session.timeZone and the pinned format silently NULLs any shape it misses, so the recorded exact match holds only at session zone America/New_York and is not reproducible elsewhere. attempt_0002 had ALREADY removed this construction; attempt_0003 reintroduced it. Replace with a bare TRY_CAST(o.effective_datetime AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ), nothing wrapped around it. charttime is load-bearing beyond its own column here: it is stringified into the UUIDv5 that witnesses 'No Response-ETT', so verify that discriminator still fires. mimic_utils validate-demo now refuses this construction (sql_lint datetime-parser).

concept.sql reconstructs the ETL's Observation.id UUIDv5 to undo a DST shift and brute-force a label vocabulary for source 'No Response-ETT'. Both uses violate the opaque-identity boundary. UTC-pinned reads plus key_attribution handle the residual New York shift; the discarded label changes core GCS outputs and carry-forward, so the reopened comparison must go to the judge for whole-concept BLOCKED_REPRESENTATION rather than a partial port.

attempt_0005/concept.sql states a value where FHIR carries none: for itemid 223900 served as Quantity 1 it scores gcs_verbal = 1, giving 576,086 differing_conflict rows, zero differing_null_only, and no NULL on any column. That is the estimate-instead-of-an-absence failure of LOOP_CONTRACT.md:406-411 -- it manufactures the conflict that forces the contested tier, then has to argue its own approximation is intrinsic, which it cannot, because the typed NULL was available. The judge's essential-loss finding at mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_observation_chartevents.sql:69-80 is UPHELD and is not what is being reopened; the ruling was passed a port that states values it does not have. Re-port emitting typed NULL for gcs and gcs_verbal wherever an itemid-223900 observation is served as Quantity 1 at this charttime or at the previous one inside the six-hour window (678,748 of 1,637,763 rows, probe job 30309450), and gcs_unable as 100% NULL declared in unrepresentable.json. No ventilation-status substitution: measured 4.7% recall from oxygen_delivery and 80.1% accuracy from the oracle ventilation table (job 30309569), both estimates rather than mappings. Rationale and numbers in human_override/gcs.md; upstream fix filed as kind-lab/mimic-fhir#125.

This changes gcs, gcs_verbal, gcs_unable, total GCS and six-hour carry-forward; 576086 differing_conflict rows plus 74 only_candidate and 98 only_oracle were observed (64.82% identical). The unrepresentability declaration for gcs_unable is now FALSE and must be removed: select the component text and derive gcs_unable from it, and drop the ambiguity-propagation logic that emitted NULL for gcs, gcs_motor, gcs_verbal and gcs_eyes on affected windows. reopen_history.superseded_justification: attempt_0006 is gap_shaped with divergence.blocking empty and differing_conflict = 0: the port states no value it does not have, on any row. The absent element is Observation.component -- mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_observation_chartevents.sql:69-80 partitions valueQuantity and valueString on the same predicate, so chartevents.value is discarded wherever valuenum exists, and itemid 223900 has valuenum on 1,627,786 of 1,627,786 rows; 'No Response' and 'No Response-ETT' both arrive as Quantity 1. That absence explains the divergence exactly: gcs and gcs_verbal NULL on 678,714 rows (the ambiguous-or-previous predicate) and gcs_unable NULL on all rows, declared and comparator-confirmed. Every defensible mapping was tried and measured, not asserted: valueString never written for 223900, component/valueCodeableConcept/dataAbsentReason not written at all, resource-id inversion forbidden, oxygen_delivery 4.7% recall and the oracle ventilation table 80.1% accuracy (Slurm job 30309569), and ventilator_setting is BLOCKED_REPRESENTATION on this same statement. Fidelity 958,951/1,637,763 identical on representable columns (58.55%); the 98 only_oracle and 74 only_candidate rows are fully attributed to the upstream DST cast at fhir_observation_chartevents.sql:9,67 with zero residual. The judge's essential-loss finding is upheld; what is overridden is the remedy, since :481's harm -- ordinary values concealing ambiguity -- is not what this port does. Conditions and full argument in human_override/gcs.md. Upstream fix filed as kind-lab/mimic-fhir#125.
